name: ExampleAnimationsMod
description: Example mod: custom battle animations. Animations.json imports a new RPGMaker style animation (ID 900, recolored mod texture), Animations.jsond fills a texture-less vanilla animation slot (ID 221) from delta ops reusing a vanilla sheet. Preview both in the main menu's Animation Viewer, and play them from C# via AnimationManager.PlayAnimation. Note: despite the name, a .jsond delta cannot modify an already-registered ID.
author: alltoasters
